offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes across the US to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, selling through its own communities and model homes, with affiliated mortgage and title services.

primary_products.value: single-family detached homes; attached townhomes; active adult homes; homesites

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time buyers, move-up buyers, active adults aged 55 and older

end_markets.value: residential construction; real estate; mortgage finance

revenue_model.value: product sales: sale of homes and homesites to buyers; interest or premiums: mortgage lending and title insurance through affiliated subsidiaries

value_chain_position.value: other: land developer and homebuilder that takes in land and materials and sells finished homes to consumers; financial intermediary: affiliated mortgage and title businesses that serve its home buyers

geography_served.value: US national: Arizona, California, Florida, Texas, Colorado, Carolinas, Georgia, Illinois and other states

specialization.value: niche specialist: single-family home building, including active adult and attached homes

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned model homes and sales centers in its communities; direct sales: in-house sales staff selling to home buyers; online: company website for home search and inquiries; agents / brokers: third-party real estate agents who bring buyers to its communities
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; online; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, environmental and land development rules, licensed mortgage and title subsidiaries
